name: tags-input-no-edit
title: Tags Input
blurb: Tag input that allows adding tags but not editing existing ones.
description: A tags input component with editing disabled, allowing users to add and remove tags but not modify existing ones inline.
use_when: When you need tag collection without the ability to edit tags after creation.
avoid_when: When users need to modify tags after creation.
a11y: Same as tags-input component but without edit capability.
